break_even_depth1.cost_model: round = draft c + verify 1 -> 1+alpha tokens; speedup = (1+alpha)/(1+c)

dataflow_mtp1.in: input_ids[t+1] -> shared embed -> pre_fc_norm_embedding; trunk hidden h[t+1] -> pre_fc_norm_hidden
dataflow_mtp1.note: vLLM comment confirms shared Qwen3.5 MTP handling (PR #38832); HF transformers 5.16.1 ignores mtp.* (no reference forward there)
dataflow_mtp1.then: 1x full-attention decoder layer (own KV cache) -> mtp.norm

gate.implement_iff: measured alpha >= 0.6 sustained over >= 20 samples AND quality gate available (T1.5)
gate.measurement_protocol: CPU streamed forward (fwd_cpu pattern): trunk steps for h + greedy tokens, MTP layer via HF Qwen3_5DecoderLayer (S0-validated path), single-slot verify; greedy acceptance = draft==trunk over corpus prompts

impl_scope_if_greenlit: MTP kernels (all ported patterns) + 1-layer MTP KV cache + draft/verify/accept loop surgery on decode_l0; ~2-3 turns
quality_note: greedy acceptance is exact-match (no distribution needed); sampling acceptance deferred with T7.1 distribution work
tensors_note: fc 52.4M + full decoder layer + 5 norms; embed/lm_head SHARED (mtp_use_dedicated_embeddings=false)
vram_extra: ~0.2 GiB INT4 weights + ~32 MiB MTP KV@4K (negligible)
